title: School Bus Monitors
description: Maintain order among students on a school bus. Duties include helping students safely board and exit and communicating behavioral problems. May perform pretrip and posttrip inspections and prepare for and assist in emergency evacuations.

tasks.text: Assist children with disabilities or children with psychological, emotional, or behavioral issues with boarding and exiting the school bus.
Buckle seatbelts or fasten wheelchair tie-down straps to secure passengers for transportation.
Direct students boarding and exiting the school bus.
Direct students evacuating the bus during safety drills.
Escort young children across roads or highways.
Evacuate students from the school bus in emergency situations.
Operate a wheelchair lift to load or unload wheelchairs.

clusters.label: Communicating with People Outside the Organization

tasks.text: Respond to students' questions, requests, or complaints.

clusters.label: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Guide the driver when the bus is moving in reverse gear.
Report delays, accidents, or other traffic and transportation situations to dispatchers or other bus drivers, using phones or mobile two-way radios.
Monitor for trains at railroad crossings and signal the bus driver when it is safe to proceed.
Monitor the conduct of students to maintain discipline and safety.
Clean school bus interiors by picking up waste, wiping down windows, or vacuuming.

clusters.label: Operating Vehicles, Mechanized Devices, or Equipment

tasks.text: Open and close school bus doors for students.

clusters.label: Resolving Conflicts and Negotiating with Others

tasks.text: Prevent or defuse altercations between students.
Talk to children's parents or guardians about problematic behaviors, emotional or developmental problems, or related issues.
Write and submit reports that include data such as the number of passengers or trips, hours worked, mileage driven, or fuel consumed.

skills.name: Operating system software
skills.def: Software to provide the operational interface to a computer and provide higher-level services and APIs. Examples: Microsoft Windows.

skills.name: Internet browser software
skills.def: Software to view the contents of web pages and to navigate from one page to another. Examples: Web browser software.
